'''Mummies''' are [[monsters]] which can be found guarding [[Klenter's Pyramid]] during and after the [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]] quest.

They are aggressive regardless of combat level, and unlike other mummies, cannot be set alight using [[fire spells]], and do not drop anything besides [[bones]]. They also possess a unique appearance.
